finding.text:
declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000), @userlogin varchar(32); set @strDetailKey = ''
select @userlogin = username from vdmnv where user_id_0 = @@userId
set @strKey = 'ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding
IF @@admin = 0 set @strKey = @strKey + ' and CHARINDEX('''+@userlogin+''', a.nguoi_check) > 0'
exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmnv c on a.ma_nv= c.ma_nv left join dmdonvi d on a.ma_dv = d.ma_dv left join dmpb e on a.ma_pb = e.ma_pb left join dmbp f on a.ma_bp = f.ma_bp and a.ma_pb = f.ma_pb left join dmhmdx g on a.ma_hmdx = g.ma_hmdx left join dmloaidx h on a.ma_loaidx = h.ma_loaidx','b.ma_unit, c.ten_nv, d.ten_dv, e.ten_pb, f.ten_bp, g.ten_hmdx, h.ten_loaidx', '@@key',@strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId

dir.script:
declare @deststatus int, @uid int, @dduyet date set @deststatus = case @xstatus when 1 then 2 when 2 then 1 else 2 end --else 9 - Huy thi tra ve duyet set @uid = case when @xstatus = 1 then @@userId else 0 end set @dduyet = case when @xstatus = 1 then getdate() else null end
update n21 set status = @deststatus, user_id_check = @uid, ngay_check = @dduyet where id in (select id from @tblKeys)
select '' as message, '$Processed' as toast
&VoucherJSLoading;
